newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-SPARTA PRAGUE INSTALL NEW COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTA PRAGUE INSTALL NEW COACH.

text.p: Sparta Prague fired trainer Vlastimil Petrzela and his assistant on Thursday after a disappointing start to the 1996 campaign and named manager Josef Chovanec as their new coach.
The Czech agency CTK said Sparta would adopt a more English-style system where coaches tend to fulfil a dual role as club manager.
Sparta stand 14th in the 16-team Czech first division without a win in their first four matches. Petrzela was only hired last December as Sparta's sixth new trainer in two years.
